correctness.rationale: The quadratic SPS ratio is exactly \(1/(2ca_i)\), so the bounded update is a finite family of affine contractions with \(r_i=\min(q,a_i\gamma_b)\), \(q=1/(2c)\). Uniform contraction gives a unique invariant law. The invariant first- and second-moment equations yield the displayed mean and variance, and direct substitution proves every phase boundary.

value.rationale: The SPS cap is an actual algorithmic parameter whose tuning affects behavior outside interpolation. The theorem shows that it clips curvature weights in the stationary target, giving an exact objective-consistency phase transition and a closed bias-variance decomposition. This is a structural benchmark for choosing or diagnosing the cap rather than a routine restatement of the known loose-cap bias.
